title: Final Prices With a Special Discount in a Shop
problemStatement: You are given an array where prices[i] is the price of the i-th item. For each item, find the first item to its right whose price is less than or equal to the current item's price. Use that value as a discount. If no such item exists, no discount is applied. Return the final price of every item after applying the discount.
output: An array representing the final prices.
